description: Unit test class for the LoanRepaymentBusinessEventSerializer, testing its serialization of loan repayment events into Avro data transfer objects, including validation and custom data handling.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentBusinessEventSerializerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the serialization of loan repayment business events into Avro format, including handling of custom data and validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes context for each test, setting tenant, action context, business dates, and mock static methods for monetary helpers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets thread-local context and closes mock static money helper after each test.

methods.name: testLoanRepaymentEventPayloadSerialization
methods.description: Tests that a loan repayment business event is correctly serialized into an Avro DTO, verifying all fields and custom data inclusion.

methods.name: testLoanRepaymentEventLoanIdMandatoryFieldValidation
methods.description: Validates that serialization throws an exception if the loan ID is null, ensuring mandatory field enforcement.

methods.name: createCustomDataForEvents
methods.description: Creates a list of mock custom data serializers used during testing to embed custom data in serialized output.
